purpose: This silver table provides cleaned, typed airport reference data sourced from OurAirports, covering every airport in the bronze extract that carries an IATA code, to feed downstream airport lookup, geocoding, and flight-operations joins.
usage: Join on airport_id (or iata_code, which is also fully populated and unique in this extract) for the declared grain; treat continent_code value NA and iso_country_code value NA as North America and Namibia respectively, not missing data; expect and handle nulls in elevation_feet, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_page_url, wikipedia_url, and keywords before aggregating or joining on those columns, since each carries a nonzero null_rate documented per column.
limitations: Cleanup could not fill gaps in sparsely populated columns: local_code is 63.7% null, home_page_url is 74.9% null, keywords is 68.0% null, icao_code is 13.7% null, and gps_code is 5.4% null; elevation_ft (elevation_feet) is 3.7% null and municipality is 4.0% null. duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across 9057 rows, so no exact-duplicate or clock-drift dedupe logic was needed or applied.
